findings.title: C6 does not yet bind the complete evaluated near-bound state, provenance, or complete inspection counters.
findings.evidence: The ordinary physical subcheck correctly observes actual capacity 0x3fd3020c49ba5e37, liquid mass 0x3fd3020c49ba5e36, wet fraction 0x3fefffffffffffff, physical/mapped certificates [false;6], and held [false;21]. Its independent gap 0x3c90000000000000 and ratio 0x3feffffffffffffe are correct. But H=+0 and D=+0 are present only in the fixture, not bound to the adapter's evaluated current coordinates. The assembly exposes actual provenance, but the test does not assert role columns, structural areas, wet fractions, or free-state operands. It asserts only completed 6/252/21 work, allowing mismatched attempted counts to escape.
findings.required_fix: Using the existing observation/assembly only, assert evaluated current M/H/D bits, exact relevant provenance (including role columns, structural areas, wet fractions and free-state flags), and attempted as well as completed 6/252/21 counts. Keep the physical subcheck and unchanged synthetic rank seam as separate subchecks inside formal C6; no same-trajectory rank claim is required.
findings.fix_verification: RESOLVED on final source: evaluated current coordinates bind M/H/D to [0x3fd3020c49ba5e36,+0,+0]; provenance binds role columns [0,1,2,6,7,8], exact six structural-area bits, initial_free [true;6], physical_current_free [false;6], and all six exact wet-fraction bits; work binds attempted and completed 6/252/21. findings.title: C2's assertion still does not establish the required upper-shade supersaturation cause.
findings.evidence: The repaired assertion proves the independently reconstructed qcan bits and matches VEG-E-142/Domain, but that code/stage is shared by multiple domain predicates. It never binds the ordered causal operands: upper sun area is zero and therefore skipped, upper shade area is positive, and qcan exceeds qsat at the upper-shade temperature.
findings.required_fix: Add independent assertions for zero upper-sun area, positive upper-shade area, and qcan greater than upper-shade saturation, preserving the existing guard order and inputs.
findings.fix_verification: RESOLVED on final source: C2 binds zero-area upper sun, positive-area upper shade, the below-freezing Ice saturation phase, and qcan>upper-shade qsat before matching VEG-E-142/Domain.

findings.title: C4 can accept the intended error before successful unpoisoned adapter evaluation is established.
findings.evidence: The helper sequences adapter.evaluate(initial_coordinates), then applies the one-ULP capacity poison, then materializes. However, the outer test accepts VEG-E-142/Domain from the helper without checking that evaluate completed. An evaluation-time error with that shared code/stage could satisfy the assertion before poisoning. The separate core operand helper does not prove the adapter evaluation/Jacobian path succeeded.
findings.required_fix: After the refusal, assert the existing adapter observation shows exactly one completed current evaluation, then retain the typed Domain match and no-materialization assertion.
findings.fix_verification: RESOLVED on final source: C4 now requires current_evaluations==1 after the helper refusal, proving the unpoisoned adapter evaluation completed before the capacity poison/materialization refusal; typed Domain and no-materialization checks remain.

findings.title: C5's subsequent reactivation remains existential instead of identifying the expected semantic roles.

findings.required_fix: Assert dry-state physical and mapped certificate arrays exactly [false;6] and the held mask exactly [false;21], thereby binding reactivation of the named upper shade/stem roles.
findings.fix_verification: RESOLVED on final source: C5 now binds dry physical and mapped certificates exactly [false;6] and dry held exactly [false;21], in addition to the already exact full-wet upper shade/stem roles.
